refusals.label: unattributed
refusals.message: the probe answered but named no owner: a health answer proves liveness, not which engine served it

refusals.label: pid-does-not-match-the-probe
refusals.message: the candidate declares PID 6464 but its probe attributed PID 7777: owner identity matched while the process did not, so the declaration describes a different process than the one that answered

refusals.label: endpoint-not-independent
refusals.message: the candidate is at http://127.0.0.1:8081, which is the incumbent's endpoint: a candidate must hold an independent port before the switch, or a failed candidate leaves the incumbent's address serving nothing

refusals.label: candidate-is-the-incumbent
refusals.message: the candidate is already the registered owner of this slot: a replacement needs a candidate with a private registration, not the incumbent replacing itself

refusals.label: generation-not-successor
refusals.message: the candidate declares generation 9 where this slot's next ownership is 2: a candidate does not choose its own generation, and a wrong one is refused rather than quietly rewritten

refusals.label: not-the-expected-environment
refusals.message: the candidate carries environment receipt env-beta but this controller requires env-alpha: an environment receipt is checked before the switch, not after it

refusals.label: not-this-slot
refusals.message: the candidate names slot slot-other but this controller owns slot slot-secode: a candidate is never registered into a slot it did not name

refusals.label: unreadable-registration
refusals.message: this slot holds bytes that decode to no record (registration has 1 lines, not the exact 9 this version defines: a record with a missing or extra field is refused rather than partially read); an ordinary replacement is refused because the prior generation is unknowable, and recovery is the explicitly named reclaim transition

refusals.label: nothing-to-reclaim
refusals.message: reclaim applies only to a slot whose bytes decode to no record; this slot is readable or empty and has an ordinary replacement path

refusals.label: upgrade-same-precedence
refusals.message: candidate version 1.3.0+other-build has the same semantic precedence as incumbent 1.3.0+candidate-build: equal precedence is not an upgrade

refusals.label: upgrade-downgrade
refusals.message: candidate version 1.2.99 has lower semantic precedence than incumbent 1.3.0+candidate-build: downgrade is refused

refusals.label: upgrade-candidate-version-unorderable
refusals.message: candidate version has no precedence: version core needs exactly 3 dot-separated fields, found 1

refusals.label: upgrade-incumbent-version-unorderable
refusals.message: incumbent version has no precedence: version core needs exactly 3 dot-separated fields, found 1

refusals.label: upgrade-no-incumbent
refusals.message: upgrade requires a readable incumbent registration; this slot is empty
